verdict.rationale: Insomnia is an API client and design/testing tool, so routing, load-balancing, and transforming live traffic between consumers and upstream services is outside its product category; that is the role of an API gateway such as Kong Gateway. Nothing in the evidence shows Insomnia acting as a gateway: pre-request scripts only change the client's own outgoing requests, mock servers return synthetic responses, and the 'protecting requests' claim belongs to Konnect.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can route, load-balance, and transform requests between consumers and upstream services
